summary: Diagonalise the string pairs by 2 × 2 orthogonal changes of basis, after matching the signs by a bijection.

steps.claim: Let σ_b = −1 for b < (s + 1)/2 and σ_b = +1 otherwise.
steps.lean: let σ (b : Fin s) := ite (b < (s + 1) / 2) (-1) (1 : ℤˣ)

steps.claim: ε and 1 ⊔ σ have the same number of minus signs (h), so ε = (1 ⊔ σ) ∘ f⁻¹ for a bijection f (exists_equiv_of_card_neg).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := exists_equiv_of_card_neg (b := 1 ⊕ᵥ σ) (card_congr e.symm) (h.trans (by
    simp (disch := lia) [σ, ↓negCount_sumElim, card_fin_lt_of_le]))

steps.claim: Take y = the block matrix that is the identity on X ⊔ {pt} and, on the string, has σ_b/√2 on the diagonal and 1/√2 (plus 1/√N at the middle index) on the anti-diagonal, reindexed by f; then yᴴJy = diag(ε), and yᴴy = 1 when N = 1 (entrywise, by cases).
steps.lean:
use gradedBlocks e f.symm 1 (of fun a b ↦ ite (a = b) ↑(σ b / √2) 0 + ite (a = b.rev) ↑(√2⁻¹ + ite
    (a = b) √N⁻¹ 0) 0), ?_, (·.symm ▸ ?_) <;> simp [σ, reindex_equiv f.symm, mul_add, apply_ite
    star, apply_ite φ] <;> intros <;> split_ifs <;> (try lia) <;> norm_cast <;> grind [Nat.cast_pos]
